blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – What does it really take to start and sustain a business in today’s changing economic landscape? More than 200 senior high school students from 21 schools across Cebu had the opportunity to hear firsthand from business leaders during the BusinessNext Forum 2026, organized by Southwestern University PHINMA B-School (Business School), in partnership with the Cebu Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CCCI), on November 14 at Milan Hall, Mezzo Hotel, Cebu City. With the theme, “From Startup to Success: The Money, The Moves, The Mindset,” the forum was organized to give students a better understanding of what happens in […]...
